- memory_id "1000223" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds as follow-up to INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000220": INC-2025-004 was caused by a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)

- memory_id "1000196" [decision]: The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28.  (about: Boreal, indexer)
- memory_id "1000193" [constraint]: The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC.  (about: webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000167" [decision]: The flags service moved from Team Atlas to the Cinder team as of 2025-02-13.  (about: Team Atlas, Cinder, flags service)
- memory_id "1000149": The reports pipeline depends on Ledger for the nightly balance export, so if Ledger is down the reports pipeline is down.  (about: Ledger, reports pipeline)
- memory_id "1000132": Ember owns the job scheduler.  (about: Ember, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000068": The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09.  (about: Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000061": Boreal owns notifier.  (about: Boreal, notifier)
- memory_id "1000057": The event bus is a Boreal service.  (about: Boreal, event bus)
- memory_id "1000048": Team Dune is a one-person team as of 2025-01-09.  (about: Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal roster consists of Lena and Marcus Oyelaran as of 2025-01-07.  (about: Boreal, Lena, Marcus Oyelaran)
